items.q: Do I need to be technical to work with you?
items.a: No. You explain how your business works and what you want to improve. I handle the technical implementation, integrations, and agreed support, while keeping you informed throughout the process.

items.q: How long until I see results?
items.a: Simple projects may be delivered within a few days, while more complex systems can take longer. Timelines depend on the project scope, required integrations, and access to the necessary tools and data.

items.q: What if I don't know what to automate yet?
items.a: That's what the Pilot is for. I review your business operations, identify promising AI automation opportunities, and provide a prioritized roadmap to help you decide what to implement first.

Data security is considered throughout the implementation process. Access is limited to what the solution requires, and appropriate security measures depend on the tools and systems involved. We agree on data access and handling before implementation.

items.q: What if the automation stops working?
items.a: I design workflows with error handling and recovery procedures where appropriate. Monitoring, alerts, troubleshooting, and ongoing maintenance depend on the project scope and support plan agreed upon.

/privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy | AIB
/privacy-policy.description: How AIB collects, uses, and protects personal information from website visitors, contact form and WhatsApp enquiries, and AI automation clients.
/privacy-policy.heading: Privacy Policy
/privacy-policy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how AIB, an independent AI automation and AI agent consultant, collects, uses, and protects personal information when you visit this website, contact me, or work with me on a project.

sections.heading: 1. Information I collect
list: Contact form details: your name, work email, company (optional), and the message you send when requesting a free AI audit.
WhatsApp messages: your phone number, profile name, and the messages you send if you contact me through WhatsApp Business.
Email correspondence: the content of emails you send me and my replies.
Client project data: business information and data you choose to give me access to during an engagement, such as customer records, spreadsheets, or documents.

Technical data: when you load this website, your browser shares standard information, such as your IP address and browser type, with the third-party services that deliver the site's fonts and styling. This website does not currently use analytics or tracking cookies. See the {cookiePolicy} for details.

sections.heading: 2. How I use your information
list: To reply to your enquiry and prepare your free AI audit.
To plan, build, test, deliver, and support the services you request.
To communicate with you about your project, invoices, and support.
To meet legal, tax, and accounting obligations.
sections.after: I do not sell your personal information, and I do not use it for advertising.

sections.heading: 3. Client business data
paragraphs: I access client business data only when it is necessary for the agreed project, and only to the extent the work requires. Before implementation, we agree in writing which systems and data I will access and how that data should be handled.
I handle client data according to those agreed instructions and do not use it for any other purpose. I protect it using reasonable security measures, as described in Section 7.

sections.heading: 4. Third-party service providers
paragraphs: I use a small number of third-party services to run this website and communicate with you. Each provider processes data under its own privacy policy:
list: Web3Forms: receives contact form submissions and delivers them to me by email.
Google (Gmail): my email provider, which stores enquiries and correspondence.
WhatsApp (Meta): handles messages if you contact me through WhatsApp Business.
Google Fonts and the Tailwind CSS content delivery network: deliver the fonts and styling used by this website.
The provider that hosts this website.
sections.after: If a client project requires additional tools or services, they are agreed with the client before any data is shared with them.

sections.heading: 5. Legal basis
paragraphs: Where data protection laws such as the EU or UK GDPR apply, I process personal information on the basis of your consent (for example, when you submit the contact form), the performance of a contract with you or steps taken at your request before entering into one, my legitimate interest in responding to enquiries and running my business, and compliance with legal obligations.

sections.heading: 6. Data retention and deletion
list: Enquiries: kept only for as long as needed to respond to you and follow up on your request. If no project follows, I delete them within a reasonable period, or sooner if you ask.
Client project data: kept only for the duration of the engagement. When the engagement ends, I return or delete it as agreed with you, unless the law requires me to keep it longer.
Invoices and accounting records: kept for as long as tax and accounting laws require.
Copies held by third-party providers (Section 4) are subject to those providers' own retention policies.
sections.after: You can ask me to delete your personal information at any time using the contact details below.

sections.heading: 7. Security
paragraphs: I use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal information, such as limiting access to what is necessary and keeping account credentials secure. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so I cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: 8. International transfers
paragraphs: I work with clients in different countries, and the providers listed in Section 4 may process data outside your country of residence. Where the law requires it, I rely on the safeguards those providers offer for international transfers.

sections.heading: 9. Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information, to receive a copy of it, to restrict or object to its processing, and to withdraw consent at any time. You may also have the right to complain to your local data protection authority.
To exercise any of these rights, email me at {email}. I will respond within the time required by applicable law.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: I may update this policy from time to time. The latest version will always be on this page with its "Last updated" date.

sections.heading: 11. Contact
paragraphs: If you have questions about this policy or how your information is handled, email {email}.

/terms-of-service.title: Terms of Service | AIB
/terms-of-service.description: The terms that apply to using the AIB website and working with AIB on AI automation, AI agents, and consulting engagements.
/terms-of-service.heading: Terms of Service
/terms-of-service.intro: These Terms of Service govern your use of this website and the AI automation and consulting services provided by AIB. By using this website or engaging my services, you agree to these terms.

sections.heading: 1. Using this website
paragraphs: The content on this website is general information about my services. It is not professional, legal, or financial advice. I aim to keep it accurate and available, but I do not guarantee that it is always complete, current, or uninterrupted.

sections.heading: 2. Services and proposals
paragraphs: The scope, deliverables, timeline, and price of each engagement (Pilot, Scale, or Enterprise) are set out in a written proposal or statement of work. If that document conflicts with these terms, the proposal or statement of work takes priority.

sections.heading: 3. Timelines
paragraphs: Timelines shown on this website are typical estimates. Actual delivery depends on the project scope, required integrations, and how quickly I receive access to the necessary tools, data, and approvals.

sections.heading: 4. Fees and payment
list: Fees are listed in your proposal. Pilot engagements are billed once, and Scale engagements are billed monthly unless agreed otherwise.
Payment terms: [payment terms, e.g. due within 14 days of invoice].
Pilot credit and refund terms shown in the pricing section apply as described there.
Third-party costs such as software subscriptions, AI API usage, and messaging fees are paid by the client unless the proposal states otherwise.

sections.heading: 5. Your responsibilities
list: Provide timely access to the accounts, tools, and data needed for the project.
Make sure you have the right to share any data you give me and to use it in automations.
Review and approve workflows before they go live.
Keep your own account credentials secure.

sections.heading: 6. AI outputs
paragraphs: AI systems can produce inaccurate or incomplete results. You are responsible for reviewing AI-generated outputs before relying on them, especially for legal, financial, medical, or other important decisions. I recommend human review for any high-impact step.

sections.heading: 7. Third-party tools
paragraphs: Automations depend on third-party platforms that I do not control. I am not responsible for their outages, policy changes, pricing changes, or discontinued features, but I will help you adapt where the agreed support plan covers it.

sections.heading: 8. Intellectual property
paragraphs: Once full payment is received, you own the deliverables created specifically for your project. My pre-existing tools, templates, and methods remain mine, and you may use them as part of the deliverables provided to you.

sections.heading: 9. Confidentiality
paragraphs: Both of us agree to keep the other's non-public business information confidential and to use it only for the engagement, unless disclosure is required by law.

sections.heading: 10. Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the extent permitted by law, I am not liable for indirect or consequential losses, such as lost profits or lost data, and my total liability for any claim is limited to the fees you paid me in the [3] months before the claim arose.

sections.heading: 11. Ending an engagement
paragraphs: Either party may end an ongoing engagement with [notice period, e.g. 14 days] written notice. Fees for work completed up to the end date remain payable.

sections.heading: 12. Changes and contact
paragraphs: I may update these terms from time to time; the latest version will always be on this page. Questions? Email {email}.

/cookie-policy.title: Cookie Policy | AIB
/cookie-policy.description: How the AIB website uses cookies, analytics, and third-party services, and how you can control them.
/cookie-policy.heading: Cookie Policy
/cookie-policy.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how this website uses cookies and similar technologies, and the choices you have.

sections.heading: 1. What cookies are
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files that a website stores in your browser. They can keep a site working, remember preferences, or measure how a site is used.

sections.heading: 2. Cookies on this website
paragraphs: At present, this website does not set its own advertising or tracking cookies, and it does not use cookies to profile visitors.

sections.heading: 3. Analytics
paragraphs: If I add analytics in the future to understand how the site is used, I will update this policy first and, where the law requires it, ask for your consent before any non-essential cookies are set.

sections.heading: 4. Third-party services
list: Fonts and styling libraries are loaded from third-party content delivery networks (such as Google Fonts), which receive your IP address to deliver the files.
When you submit the contact form, your details are sent to Web3Forms so they can be delivered to me by email.
When you click the WhatsApp button, you leave this site and WhatsApp's own cookie and privacy policies apply.

sections.heading: 5. Managing cookies
paragraphs: You can block or delete cookies at any time in your browser settings. Blocking cookies will not stop this website from working.

sections.heading: 6. Changes and contact
paragraphs: I may update this policy when the website changes. Questions? Email {email}.
